blockingFindings.description: Direct neutral views show the 20 mm longer overskirt concealing the shorts hem better. In crouch the shorts remain conspicuous, and in sit the overskirt lifts and exposes most of the upper thighs; opaque coverage is not balanced across motion poses.

The front now shows repeated vertical fold lines, but the skirt still reads mainly as a plain flare. Rear and side views retain coarse angular wrinkles and abrupt facets that obscure an even pleated form.
The enlarged rear waist tab remains nearly flush and faint in the direct back view; its outline and buckle do not read clearly as an adjustment detail.
Across the five views the jacket remains mostly plain ivory with a broad diagonal lavender panel; visible piping, seam trim, and quilting detail remain insufficient.
No authored UV layout exists for the current weighted garment mesh; UV status remains NOT_CREATED.
